@@ -30,16 +30,24 @@ The example below shows how to write text to a `Log` widget:
 
 
 
+## Following new entries
+
+With `auto_scroll=True`, new writes scroll to the end only while `Log.is_following_end` is true.
+Scrolling up pauses following and keeps the visible content in place as entries arrive or old lines are pruned.
+Scrolling back to the end resumes following automatically.
+Call [Log.follow_end][textual.widgets.Log.follow_end] to return to the end explicitly, optionally with `animate=True`.
+This works even when `auto_scroll` is disabled, although subsequent writes still respect `auto_scroll`.
+
 ## Reactive Attributes
 
 | Name          | Type   | Default | Description                                                  |
 | ------------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
 | `max_lines`   | `int`  | `None`  | Maximum number of lines in the log or `None` for no maximum. |
-| `auto_scroll` | `bool` | `False` | Scroll to end of log when new lines are added.               |
+| `auto_scroll` | `bool` | `True` | Follow new lines while at the end of the log.               |

-This widget posts no messages.
+- [Log.FollowChanged][textual.widgets.Log.FollowChanged] is posted only when `is_following_end` changes. It carries `widget`, `is_following_end`, `scroll_y`, and `max_scroll_y`.

+"""Explore log follow state and RichLog's expanding renderables."""
+
+from rich.text import Text
+
+from textual import on
+from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
+from textual.containers import Horizontal, Vertical
+from textual.widgets import Button, Footer, Header, Label, Log, RichLog
+
+
+class RichLogFollowStateApp(App[None]):
+    """Scroll through history, append entries, and explicitly resume following."""
+
+    TITLE = "Following the logs"
+    SUB_TITLE = "Scroll up to pause. Return to the end to follow."
+    CSS = """
+    Screen { background: $background; }
+    #logs { height: 1fr; padding: 1 2 0 2; }
+    .pane { width: 1fr; }
+    #plain-pane { margin-right: 2; }
+    Label { color: $text-muted; margin-bottom: 1; }
+    #plain-log, #rich-log {
+        height: 1fr;
+        border: round $primary;
+        padding: 0 1;
+    }
+    .actions { height: auto; margin-top: 1; }
+    Button { min-width: 12; margin-right: 1; }
+    #write-expanded { margin-top: 1; }
+    #event-panel { height: 10; padding: 1 2; }
+    #event-toolbar { height: 3; align-vertical: middle; }
+    #event-toolbar Label { width: 1fr; margin: 1 0 0 0; }
+    #events { height: 1fr; border-left: thick $secondary; padding-left: 1; }
+    """
+    BINDINGS = [("q", "quit", "Quit")]
+
+    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
+        yield Header()
+        with Horizontal(id="logs"):
+            with Vertical(id="plain-pane", classes="pane"):
+                yield Label("LOG / PLAIN TEXT")
+                yield Log(id="plain-log", max_lines=100)
+                with Horizontal(classes="actions"):
+                    yield Button("Follow Log", id="follow-log", variant="primary")
+                    yield Button("Append line", id="append-log")
+            with Vertical(classes="pane"):
+                yield Label("RICHLOG / RICH CONTENT")
+                yield RichLog(id="rich-log", min_width=1, max_lines=100)
+                with Horizontal(classes="actions"):
+                    yield Button("Follow Rich", id="follow-rich", variant="primary")
+                    yield Button("Append line", id="append-rich")
+                yield Button("Write expanded", id="write-expanded", variant="success")
+        with Vertical(id="event-panel"):
+            with Horizontal(id="event-toolbar"):
+                yield Label("FOLLOW STATE EVENTS")
+                yield Button("Clear events", id="clear-events")
+            yield RichLog(id="events", min_width=1, max_lines=100)
+        yield Footer()
+
+    def on_mount(self) -> None:
+        self._log_count = self._rich_count = 0
+        for _ in range(40):
+            self.append_log()
+            self.append_rich()
+
+    @on(Button.Pressed, "#follow-log")
+    def follow_log(self) -> None:
+        self.query_one("#plain-log", Log).follow_end()
+
+    @on(Button.Pressed, "#follow-rich")
+    def follow_rich(self) -> None:
+        self.query_one("#rich-log", RichLog).follow_end()
+
+    @on(Button.Pressed, "#append-log")
+    def append_log(self) -> None:
+        self._log_count += 1
+        self.query_one("#plain-log", Log).write_line(
+            f"{self._log_count:03}  An ordinary log entry"
+        )
+
+    @on(Button.Pressed, "#append-rich")
+    def append_rich(self) -> None:
+        self._rich_count += 1
+        self.query_one("#rich-log", RichLog).write(
+            f"{self._rich_count:03}  An ordinary RichLog entry"
+        )
+
+    @on(Button.Pressed, "#write-expanded")
+    def write_expanded(self) -> None:
+        self.query_one("#rich-log", RichLog).write(
+            Text(
+                "An expanded, right-justified entry", justify="right", style="on blue"
+            ),
+            expand=True,
+        )
+
+    @on(Button.Pressed, "#clear-events")
+    def clear_events(self) -> None:
+        self.query_one("#events", RichLog).clear()
+
+    @on(Log.FollowChanged)
+    @on(RichLog.FollowChanged)
+    def record_follow_change(
+        self, event: Log.FollowChanged | RichLog.FollowChanged
+    ) -> None:
+        if event.widget.id == "events":
+            return
+        self.query_one("#events", RichLog).write(
+            f"{event.widget.id} FollowChanged: following={event.is_following_end} "
+            f"scroll_y={event.scroll_y:g} max_scroll_y={event.max_scroll_y}"
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    RichLogFollowStateApp().run()

@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+"""Shared follow state for the log widgets."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from textual.events import Resize
+from textual.message import Message
+from textual.scroll_view import ScrollView
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FollowChanged(Message):
+    """The log's follow state changed."""
+
+    widget: ScrollView
+    """The log whose follow state changed."""
+    is_following_end: bool
+    """Whether the log is following its end."""
+    scroll_y: float
+    """Vertical scroll position at the time of the change."""
+    max_scroll_y: int
+    """Maximum vertical scroll position at the time of the change."""
+
+    @property
+    def control(self) -> ScrollView:
+        """The log whose follow state changed."""
+        return self.widget
+
+
+class LogScrollView(ScrollView):
+    """A scroll view which remembers whether new log entries should be followed."""
+
+    FollowChanged = FollowChanged
+    _is_following_end = True
+    _follow_animation = False
+
+    @property
+    def is_following_end(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether the log is following the end of its content."""
+        return self._is_following_end
+
+    def _set_following_end(self, following: bool) -> None:
+        if following != self._is_following_end:
+            self._is_following_end = following
+            self.post_message(
+                self.FollowChanged(self, following, self.scroll_y, self.max_scroll_y)
+            )
+
+    def watch_scroll_y(self, old_value: float, new_value: float) -> None:
+        super().watch_scroll_y(old_value, new_value)
+        if self._follow_animation:
+            if new_value < old_value or self.scroll_target_y < self.max_scroll_y:
+                self._follow_animation = False
+            elif not self.is_vertical_scroll_end:
+                return
+            else:
+                self._follow_animation = False
+        self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)
+
+    def follow_end(self, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Scroll to the end and resume following, even if auto_scroll is disabled.
+
+        Args:
+            animate: Animate the scroll to the end.
+        """
+        self._follow_animation = animate
+        self.scroll_end(animate=animate, immediate=True, x_axis=False)
+        self._set_following_end(True)
+        self.call_after_refresh(self._scroll_following_end, animate)
+
+    def _scroll_following_end(self, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Follow after layout, unless scrolling has since released follow."""
+        if self.is_following_end:
+            self._follow_animation = animate
+            self.scroll_end(animate=animate, immediate=True, x_axis=False)
+
+    def _should_follow(self, scroll_end: bool | None, auto_scroll: bool) -> bool:
+        return (
+            (auto_scroll if scroll_end is None else scroll_end)
+            and self.is_following_end
+            and not self.is_vertical_scrollbar_grabbed
+        )
+
+    def _finish_write(
+        self, follow: bool, scroll_y: float, removed: int = 0, animate: bool = False
+    ) -> None:
+        """Restore the viewport after changing the log's content."""
+        if follow:
+            self.follow_end(animate)
+        else:
+            if removed:
+                self.scroll_to(y=max(0, scroll_y - removed), animate=False)
+            self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)
+        self.refresh()
+
+    def _on_resize(self, event: Resize) -> None:
+        if self.is_following_end and getattr(self, "auto_scroll", False):
+            self.call_after_refresh(self._scroll_following_end)
+        else:
+            self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)

+"""Follow state, viewport preservation, and expanded RichLog rendering."""
+
+import pytest
+from rich.text import Text
+
+from textual import on
+from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
+from textual.widgets import Log, RichLog
+
+
+class LogApp(App):
+    CSS = "Log, RichLog { height: 8; width: 30; }"
+
+    def __init__(self, widget):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.log_widget = widget
+        self.changes = []
+
+    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
+        yield self.log_widget
+
+    @on(Log.FollowChanged)
+    @on(RichLog.FollowChanged)
+    def follow_changed(self, event):
+        self.changes.append(event)
+
+
+def append(log, count=1):
+    for index in range(count):
+        if isinstance(log, Log):
+            log.write_line(f"line {index:03}")
+        else:
+            log.write(f"line {index:03}")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("widget_type", [Log, RichLog])
+async def test_follow_state_and_viewport(widget_type):
+    log = widget_type()
+    app = LogApp(log)
+    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
+        append(log, 30)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        assert log.scroll_y == log.max_scroll_y
+        assert not app.changes
+
+        bottom = log.render_line(0).text
+        log.scroll_to(y=10, animate=False)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        assert log.vertical_scrollbar.position == 10
+        assert log.render_line(0).text != bottom
+        visible = log.render_line(0).text
+        assert [event.is_following_end for event in app.changes] == [False]
+        event = app.changes[0]
+        assert event.widget is log and event.control is log
+        assert event.scroll_y == 10 and event.max_scroll_y == log.max_scroll_y
+
+        append(log, 3)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == 10
+        assert log.render_line(0).text == visible
+        assert len(app.changes) == 1
+
+        log.scroll_end(animate=False, immediate=True)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        append(log)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == log.max_scroll_y
+        assert [event.is_following_end for event in app.changes] == [False, True]
+        log.follow_end()
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert len(app.changes) == 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["write", "write_line", "write_lines", "rich"])
+async def test_pruning_preserves_visible_content(method):
+    log = RichLog(max_lines=30) if method == "rich" else Log(max_lines=30)
+    app = LogApp(log)
+
+    def write(value):
+        if method == "write":
+            log.write(value + "\n")
+        elif method == "write_line":
+            log.write_line(value)
+        elif method == "write_lines":
+            log.write_lines([value])
+        else:
+            log.write(value)
+
+    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
+        for index in range(30):
+            write(f"line {index:03}")
+        await pilot.pause()
+        log.scroll_to(y=10, animate=False)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        visible = log.render_line(0).text
+        for index in range(3):
+            write(f"new {index}")
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == 7
+        assert log.scroll_target_y == 7
+        assert log.vertical_scrollbar.position == 7
+        assert log.render_line(0).text == visible
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        assert log.virtual_size.height == 30
+        assert len(app.changes) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("widget_type", [Log, RichLog])
+async def test_follow_with_auto_scroll_disabled_and_clear(widget_type):
+    log = widget_type(auto_scroll=False)
+    app = LogApp(log)
+    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
+        append(log, 30)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == 0
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        log.follow_end()
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == log.max_scroll_y
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        append(log)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        log.clear()
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        assert log.scroll_y == 0
+        assert [event.is_following_end for event in app.changes] == [
+            False,
+            True,
+            False,
+            True,
+        ]
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("deferred", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("justify", ["left", "center", "right"])
+async def test_expanded_rendering_tracks_width(deferred, justify):
+    log = RichLog(min_width=1)
+    text = Text("hello", justify=justify, style="on blue")
+    if deferred:
+        log.write(text, expand=True)
+    app = LogApp(log)
+    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
+        if not deferred:
+            log.write(text, expand=True)
+        await pilot.pause()
+
+        def check(width):
+            expected = {"left": str.ljust, "center": str.center, "right": str.rjust}
+            assert log.lines[0].text == expected[justify]("hello", width)
+            assert log.lines[0].cell_length == width
+            assert log.virtual_size.width == width
+
+        check(log.scrollable_content_region.width)
+        log.styles.width = 42
+        await pilot.pause()
+        check(log.scrollable_content_region.width)
+        log.min_width = 60
+        await pilot.pause()
+        check(60)
+        log.min_width = 1
+        log.styles.width = 24
+        await pilot.pause()
+        check(log.scrollable_content_region.width)
+

+async def test_expanded_pruning_and_fixed_width():
+    log = RichLog(min_width=1, max_lines=3)
+    async with LogApp(log).run_test() as pilot:
+        log.write(Text("old\nretained", justify="right"), expand=True)
+        log.write(Text("fixed", justify="right"), width=12, expand=True)
+        log.write("ordinary")
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert len(log.lines) == 3
+        log.styles.width = 40
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert len(log.lines) == 3
+        assert log.lines[0].text == "retained".rjust(
+            log.scrollable_content_region.width
+        )
+        assert log.lines[1].text == "fixed".rjust(12)
+        assert log.lines[2].text == "ordinary"
+        log.clear()
+        log.styles.width = 20
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert not log.lines

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("widget_type", [Log, RichLog])
+async def test_animated_follow_and_cancel_pending_follow(widget_type):
+    log = widget_type()
+    app = LogApp(log)
+    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
+        append(log, 30)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        # A queued follow from this write must not override a later user scroll.
+        append(log)
+        log.scroll_to(y=5, animate=False)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == 5
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        log.follow_end(animate=True)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        await pilot.wait_for_scheduled_animations()
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        assert log.scroll_y == log.max_scroll_y
+        assert [event.is_following_end for event in app.changes] == [False, True]
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("widget_type", [Log, RichLog])
+async def test_keyboard_scrolling_refreshes_viewport(widget_type):
+    log = widget_type()
+    async with LogApp(log).run_test() as pilot:
+        append(log, 30)
+        await pilot.pause()
+        log.focus()
+        # The compositor must receive a refresh, not only the scroll coordinates.
+        before = dict(log._styles_cache._cache)
+        await pilot.press("home")
+        await pilot.wait_for_scheduled_animations()
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.scroll_y == 0
+        assert log.vertical_scrollbar.position == 0
+        assert log._styles_cache._cache != before
+        assert not log.is_following_end
+        await pilot.press("end")
+        await pilot.wait_for_scheduled_animations()
+        await pilot.pause()
+        assert log.is_following_end
+        assert log.vertical_scrollbar.position == log.max_scroll_y

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("widget_type", [Log, RichLog])
+def test_clear_before_mount(widget_type):
